column3: New version of gen_traces.py 59966c883510 (relocation tool set 718254b3f4dd), the generator of record of the trace lists of proofs/libreac/fuzz_disco/lib/Reusable/YCej.v: finds the calls of the memory-checking runtime's malloc / free entries in the image's .text and writes CTX_ / TRACES_ per calling function and the prefix-closed Tfib_universe. Changes from the copy of record: the decoder path is kit/ beside the script (was a host path) and the SYMS help text names the extract; no logic changed. run.sh re-derives ycej.gen.v byte for byte.

New version of resolve_code.py 81803218fe79 (same tool set), imported by gen_traces.py for sym_ranges (function symbols; read here from the nm-text extract through its existing .txt branch) and text_code (the .text decode). Changes: the decoder path is kit/ beside the script; it names the two kit tools by their new names kit/elf_symbols.py and kit/numeral_map.py, in its text and in its one lazy import (the map cross-check of its script mode, which this re-run does not use and whose kit file is not in this directory); no logic changed.

New version of the kit's rvelf.py (a stdlib ELF64 reader and the RV64GC decoder), imported by gen_traces.py and resolve_code.py. Change: its docstring names the kit files by their new names (kit/elf_symbols.py, kit/numeral_map.py); no logic changed. Same bytes as core-Y/kit/rvelf.py.

Extract script: writes the function symbols of image B's unstripped twin (every STT_FUNC symbol of non-zero size: address, size, T or t, name) as nm text, the form resolve_code.sym_ranges reads in place of the twin; optional NAMEs keep only those symbols. Its header names the twin's and the pin's sha256 and that PT_LOAD 2..4 of twin and pin are byte-equal (checked; it refuses otherwise). Same bytes as yb1v/extract_syms.py.

extract_syms.py output on image B's twin and pin: 1445 function symbols. gen_traces.py reads it in place of the twin; sym_ranges returns the same 1445 ranges from it as from the twin (measured). run.sh with TWIN_B makes it again and compares.

The generated trace lists of proofs/libreac/fuzz_disco/lib/Reusable/YCej.v: the recorded gen_traces.py output (20 traces from 12 call sites in LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput, main and target_run), re-derived byte for byte by run.sh. The shipped YCej.v is this table plus hand-written text: the header, the YG00 / YG01 Require line, the 5 CTX_ lists (the donor's call-site return addresses carried through the function-pair offsets: main 0x8fbf8, target_alloc_init 0x80c7c, target_alloc_count 0x80ca0, target_run 0x80c90, emit_printf 0x80ec8), the definition order, and the TRACES_*_U / Tfib_universe_ok proof block in place of the count comment; no per-value table holds the CTX_ carry.

The re-run of ycej.gen.v: with TWIN_B, extract_syms.py makes the symbol extract again and cmp checks it; then gen_traces.py on IMG_B (linked under the name fuzz_disco, the file name the recorded output's first line names) and the extract; cmp with ycej.gen.v: equal. The arguments of the run of record are not recorded: --ipc malloc=0x536f8 / free=0x53598 and --fp LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput=0x80eb8 are the values the shipped YCej.v header names, and --exclude of libunwind's FDE cache matches the recorded output (without it the tool adds that function's 2 call sites as 2 more traces).
